<summary>
Task: Build supply-side potential-GDP model for Georgia in /root/test-supply.xlsx using Excel formulas only. Involves collecting PWT rnna, ECB CFC, IMF WEO real GDP+growth; HP filter with Solver; Cobb-Douglas projection with 6.5B USD/8-year investment shock starting 2026.

Progress through Turn 30:

Data acquisition (now complete):
- PWT rnna for Georgia obtained two ways:
  1. DBnomics GGDC/penn10 series rnna.GEO (Turn 17): 1990–2019 values. Note: only through 2019. 2019 value = 298215.06. 1990=269494.41.
  2. Downloaded CRAN pwt10 R-package tarball from https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/pwt10_10.01-0.tar.gz (Turn 21, 2.7MB), extracted to /tmp/pwt10/data/pwt10.01.rda, installed pyreadr with --break-system-packages, read the rda file (Turn 27). Georgia rnna 1990–2019 available, values DIFFER from DBnomics (e.g., 1990=217572.27, 2019=264125.56). The two sources give inconsistent rnna values — likely different PWT revisions/versions. The pyreadr file is labeled "pwt10.01"; DBnomics penn10 also should be PWT 10.01 — discrepancy unresolved. Task requires data through 2023 in CFC sheet (years 1996–2023) and PWT sheet (1990–2023) — PWT 10.01 only has data through 2019, so post-2019 rnna cells will remain blank or need extrapolation. Agent has not confirmed which source to use; DBnomics rnna.GEO shows higher levels ~13% larger.
  3. Confirmed via Turn 28 that PWT10.01 is the newest release (RuG page returns only "pwt1001"; no newer CRAN pwt versions exist).

- ECB CFC (IDCM.A.N.GE.W2.S1.S1.D.P51C.N1G._T._Z.XDC.V.N) fully retrieved (Turn 29–30) for 1996–2023 in XDC (domestic currency GEL), UNIT_MULT=6 (millions). Full time series available: 1996=304.52 million GEL up to 2023=9410.66 million GEL. (2013 anomaly: 1555.93M, dip vs neighbors ~2643 and 2984.) Values ready to populate CFC data sheet Column C.

- IMF WEO data: not yet fetched via API/Playwright, but the workbook already contains embedded WEO values for Georgia 2000–2027 in low-visibility rows (identified in earlier turns): GDP level and growth (e.g., 2025 level=71.54, growth=5.977; 2026 growth=5; 2027 growth=5). These can be referenced or transcribed.

Not yet done:
- Populate PWT sheet Column B (rnna) — need to choose data source and enter values; 2020–2023 will be missing.
- Populate CFC data sheet Column C (CFC values, unit: need to align to same currency/scale as capital stock — capital stock in PWT is in millions 2017 US$; ECB CFC is in current GEL millions — a MISMATCH exists that agent has not addressed. Depreciation rate = C/D will be dimensionally incorrect if raw values used).
- Populate WEO_Data sheet rows 8–51 with real GDP and growth 2000–2027 plus extended growth of 5% through 2043, and formula-projected GDP levels for 2028–2043.
- Fill CFC data Column D (link from PWT rnna), Column E (=C/D formula).
- Production sheet: B3 avg depreciation formula, D6:D27 K link, E6:E27 Y link, F/G LnK/LnY formulas.
- Build HP filter columns L/M/N/O/P and set up Solver.
- Build production-function block rows 36–75 with K/Y, extended K, TREND-extended LnZ, Ystar_base, Investment link, ΔK, K_With, Ystar_with, uplift, projected GDP.

Environmental notes: no Playwright/MCP tooling; only terminal + task_tracker; pyreadr installed via --break-system-packages; skill script /skills/xlsx/recalc.py exists (not yet invoked in this window).

No "task infeasible" signal from agent. Agent is progressing but has not yet begun writing any values or formulas into the workbook — all work in this window has been data retrieval. Key open issue: reconcile the PWT rnna source discrepancy and address the unit mismatch between PWT capital stock (2017 US$ millions) and ECB CFC (current GEL millions) when computing depreciation rate.
</summary>
